description: Find exact products with issued affiliate routes. Requires query, destinationCountry and currency; preserve option, quantity, region, budget and benefits. Use responseMode brief. Returned URLs are not current stock or checkout.

budget.description: Buyer spending ceiling in one explicit currency; preserved locally, never payment authorization or a delivered-total quote.

includeVerificationPlans.description: With responseMode brief only, true includes original read-only source verification plans, preserving exact product/variant, quantity, destination, budget, per-unit ceiling and benefits. Avoid an extra full-detail query when the buyer or client wants source verification next. Plans may be unsupported or blocked; no source/affiliate/cart/payment request executes. Default false.

maxOptionPrice.description: Nonnegative ceiling on a dated exact Keychron option unit price. Requires optionQuery, sellerId keychron and USD; excludes unknown prices, shipping and tax. Zero candidate results include bounded optionBudgetEvidence for the same named option, preserving destination and buyer ceiling. Not current inventory, final total or buyer spending authorization.

optionQuery.description: Literal terms in one recorded option name. Requires sellerId; incompatible with product-price/unit filters. Revalidate exact option before budgeting or purchase.

optionQueryMode.description: Requires optionQuery. Default terms is literal-token discovery. exact matches the entire case-sensitive recorded option name, including spaces and punctuation; no trimming, normalization or variant substitution. terms allows up to100characters; exact allows up to200characters.

productCondition.description: Exact recorded merchant-declared product condition. Unknown or mixed/unclassified condition is excluded when supplied. Not independent inspection, grade equivalence, current availability or a selected-option guarantee.

productId.description: Exact case-sensitive Hadacart catalog product ID. Applied together with every other filter; an unknown ID or mismatch returns zero candidates without falling back to title search. Not a provider variant ID.

purchaseMode.description: Exact recorded advertised purchase mode. Unknown modes are excluded when supplied. Normal-purchase advertised price is not a rental/monthly quote or buyer-specific selected-option/final total.

purchasePreferences.description: Buyer choices for this product. Not payment credentials or authorization. Store/order country must be independently known; never inferred from destination. Preserve benefits even when commission is excluded.

benefits.description: Purchase benefits intended by the buyer. Omitted means unknown; [] means no benefits selected. Never drop buyer benefits to obtain commission.

merchantStoreCountry.description: Actual country storefront selected at merchant; not inferred from buyer language or shipping destination.

orderCountry.description: Order geography as recognized by the affiliate provider; do not infer this from IP or language.

paymentMethod.description: Buyer payment preference only; not payment credentials or proof of merchant acceptance. Preserve this preference even when commission is excluded.

quantity.description: Requested number of merchant listing configurations or packages, not individual contents. When omitted, quantity1 is explicitly an example. Preserved in read-only verification/preparation plans. Does not reserve stock, apply a merchant selection, change per-unit price ceilings or authorize payment.

query.description: Recorded product name, brand, merchant/category and identity-reviewed primary title and exact-product dated primary-source labels; literal reviewed weights, no general conversion or SKU/option matching. Use optionQuery for recorded exact options.

responseMode.description: Use brief for candidate discovery with lower response volume. Retains all candidate facts, source dates, buyer constraints, destination/benefit/affiliate assessments and original issued URLs; omits repeated preparation/verification templates and related-guide lists. Full detail requests are returned without execution. Default full preserves existing clients. Neither mode verifies current stock, delivery, payment or revenue.

unitPriceCeiling.description: Buyer ceiling per one exact selected merchant listing/configuration, in explicit native currency. Not a per-100g/reference-unit filter or total budget. Preserve quantity, option, benefits and currency; no conversion, current quote or payment permission.

name: find_purchase_candidates
